President Trump's approval ratings continue to show a majority of Americans disapprove of the job he is doing in his second term.

Overall, 59% disapprove, and 35% approve, not the kind of numbers that can make the Republican Party comfortable in a year of midterm elections. The nonstop news cycle of saying the war with Iran is over, there is a peace agreement, only to have the fighting continue is wearing on the public. [...] ## Virginia
